prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED COBALT flat color field — think #335CFF, the
color of autonomy, escape, and new paths on a semantic map. The hue
must read as BRIGHT COBALT, not ocean navy, not shelf blue, not cyan
witness. Clearly distinct from all water and ice terrain tiles. Fill
the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-edge with this one cobalt color
corner to corner — NO drawn hex, NO paper border, NO vignette, NO
centered composition, NO symbols, NO roads, NO figures, NO script. Only
the faintest paint-texture variation within the same cobalt hue. A
semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Saturated cobalt flat-wash terrain tile in bold comic-map ink, pure vivid cobalt blue field filling the entire square edge-to-edge, faint brushstroke texture variation within the same bright cobalt hue, no figures or symbols.

subjects.description: Uniform bright cobalt paint field, full 1024x1024 coverage corner to corner, subtle dry-brush texture variation within the single hue, reading as vivid electric cobalt distinct from navy or sky
